create_xecguard_guardrail: create an XecGuardGuardrail instance with an API key to scan LLM conversations for policy violations
apply_xecguard_guardrail: apply the XecGuardGuardrail to block unsafe prompts or responses during pre_call or post_call hooks
configure_xecguard_policies: configure custom policy names and grounding strictness on the XecGuardGuardrail guardrail class
call_xecguard_scan: call the XecGuard scan endpoint to check conversation messages against prompt injection and harmful content policies
call_xecguard_grounding: call the XecGuard grounding endpoint to validate assistant responses against supplied reference documents
